deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.note: Submit the application by the deadline even if recommendation letters and test scores have not yet arrived.

english.note: International applicants must submit English proficiency scores unless exempt. Central TOEFL/IELTS score thresholds exempt admitted students from the ISE exam; they are not stated as admission minimums.

applicationFee.note: Fee waivers are offered for qualifying categories. Financial-hardship waivers are restricted to U.S. citizens/permanent residents. International applicants should confirm eligibility for other categories with the program.

documents: Electronic copies of official transcripts from all colleges and universities attended; student-portal unofficial transcripts are not accepted
requirements.note: Applicants should demonstrate research ability and experience.

funding.note: USC aims to fully fund doctoral students, generally with tuition, a living stipend and health benefits; the source states an aim rather than a funding guarantee.
